title: The hands, drawing
logline: The drafting table from above and behind: two hands, a pen, a page with a seawall on it half done, the lamp. No head in the frame. The sequence's rule from directly above.

panels.composition: From above and behind a drafting table: two hands, one holding a pen, over a half-drawn page of a seawall, the lamp's circle, the edge of a plaid shoulder, no head in frame.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from above and behind a drafting table, two hands one holding a pen over a half-drawn page showing a seawall, a lamp's circle of light and the edge of a plaid shoulder, no head in frame, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
